summary: Retest of the /api/inspire -> Cook Mode fix (_build_instructions normalization + single LLM retry). VERIFIED FIXED. Cleared db.inspire_cache, then ran 5 forced-refresh (refresh=true) calls (one per category) plus cached second calls: new suite /app/backend/tests/test_inspire_refresh_all.py = 15/15 PASS (no 500s, every recipe >=3 steps, no leftover '1.'/'Step 1:' numbering, cached responses keep instructions, no _id leak). Existing regression suite test_inspire_instructions.py = 13/13 PASS (was 6/13). diag_inspire_failrate.py = FAIL RATE 0/6 (was 4/6). Frontend E2E on mobile 390x844: all 5 tabs (breakfast, lunch, dinner, snack, dessert) loaded a grid, first card -> Start Cooking opened [data-testid=cook-mode] with numbered steps and NO [data-testid=cook-missing] in any category. Shuffle on breakfast refreshed the list (first card changed) with no error card/toast, and Start Cooking still worked on the new recipe; step navigation (cook-next-btn) advanced correctly. Zero React duplicate-key warnings and zero console errors on the inspire render.

minor.issue: Retry is best-effort only: if both LLM attempts return zero parseable recipes the endpoint still 500s 'No recipes returned'. Not reproduced in this run (0/6 + 5/5 fresh calls all 200), but there is still no cached/static fallback for a whole-category outage. Low risk, monitor.

issues: Recipe photos come from loremflickr keyword search and are frequently only loosely relevant — e.g. the 'Shakshuka' card rendered a photo of a chef eating rather than the dish. Cosmetic/content-quality only; images do load (naturalWidth=940, opacity 1).

action_items: No blocking action required for the inspire/Cook Mode fix — it is verified across backend and frontend.
Optional: consider serving the last good cached batch (even if stale) instead of 500 when both LLM attempts fail.
Optional: improve recipe image relevance (image_query -> better photo source) — loremflickr results are often off-topic.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:360 _build_instructions() correctly handles str/dict/other and strips leading numbering — good RCA fix; the same helper should ideally be reused for any other list-of-objects fields the model can emit (already applied via _build_recipe, used by /suggest and /ask-recipes too).
server.py is now 1019 lines — still worth splitting the LLM prompt/parsing helpers into a separate module.
/api/inspire retry doubles worst-case latency (two sequential LLM calls, up to ~60s); consider a lower per-call timeout so the endpoint cannot exceed the frontend fetch timeout.

success_rate.backend: 100% (28/28 pytest cases across the two inspire suites; diag fail rate 0/6)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (5/5 categories reached Cook Mode; shuffle + step nav OK)

seed_data_creation: Cleared db.inspire_cache before testing; fresh LLM calls repopulated all 5 categories with valid instructions.
test_credentials: N/A - app is fully public, no auth
context_for_next_testing_agent: Inspire instructions bug is CLOSED. Regression suites: /app/backend/tests/test_inspire_refresh_all.py (5 forced-refresh LLM calls, ~2 min, clears nothing — clear db.inspire_cache first for a truly cold run) and /app/backend/tests/test_inspire_instructions.py (uses cache, ~22s). diag_inspire_failrate.py measures the 500 rate over 6 fresh calls (~4 min). Frontend E2E flow: /inspire -> [data-testid=inspire-tab-<cat>] -> wait inspire-grid|inspire-error -> recipe-card-0 -> start-cook-mode-btn -> assert cook-mode and not cook-missing. Untested this iteration: /api/suggest, /ask-recipes, /analyze-meal, scan flows, favorites/shopping list (covered by older iterations' test files).
rca_of_the_issue: Original RCA (iteration 14): gpt-4o-mini non-deterministically returns instructions as a list of dicts; _build_recipe filtered to strings only -> instructions=[] -> the guard dropped all recipes -> 500. Fix validated: _build_instructions() normalizes str/dict/scalar items and strips leading step numbering, plus /api/inspire retries once. Measured post-fix failure rate 0/6 fresh calls and 0/5 categories failing in E2E.
